svg.title: Before and after the yellow line
svg.desc: Small multiples: displacement orders, white phosphorus attacks, fires, and detonations and demolitions, before the yellow line was announced (1 March to 12 April 2026) and after it (20 April to 14 October 2026), each kind on its own scale shared by both rows.
svg.text: Before and after the yellow line was announced (18 April 2026)
Each kind is counted apart and drawn on its own scale, the same in both rows. Rates are per week of the period.
The published counts are weekly and the yellow line was announced on a Saturday, so the week of 13 to 19 April 2026 is drawn in neither row: 2 orders, 2
white phosphorus attacks, 7 fires and 13 detonations and demolitions.
Displacement orders not shaded: those naming no town (31 before, 3 after), a place with no mapped point (19 before, 7 after) or a town beyond the frame (14
